hook.support_html: Not the model. Not the prompt. The spec — because an agent can only execute what's been framed clearly enough to execute.

code.title: What a sharp spec looks like

fields.name: Outcome
fields.definition: Who benefits, what changes for them, how you know it shipped.
fields.pm: "Admins onboard a 500-person team in one step — currently takes a week"
fields.takeaway_html: The eng version describes the work. The PM version describes the change in the world.

fields.name: Constraint
fields.definition: Budget, deadline, risk tolerance, things already ruled out.
fields.pm: "Must not increase queue latency by more than 10ms — SLO already tight"
fields.takeaway_html: Constraints without why turn into suggestions. Name the reason and the number.

fields.name: Slice
fields.definition: Smallest real thing that proves the outcome.
fields.pm: "Import 10 users from a CSV end-to-end before adding SSO path"
fields.takeaway_html: A slice is deployable, not a checkpoint. If it can't be demoed, it's not a slice.

fields.name: Acceptance
fields.definition: The exact check the agent's output must pass.
fields.pm: "Given a 500-row CSV, admin sees confirmation in under 10s, zero errors"
fields.takeaway_html: Written before prompting. Otherwise you'll edit it to match what the agent produced.

pattern.title: Same team. Different specs.

card_left.desc: Agent drafts 4 approaches. PM picks one. Rework on review. Ships week 3.

card_right.desc: Agent ships draft day 1. PM accepts day 2. Ships day 3.

pattern.closer_html: Same agent. Same PM. The spec changed.

cta.question: Pick one ticket on your board. Rewrite the spec with these 4 fields.
cta.closer: Run it through your agent before the standup.

bonus.title: Copy-paste template
bonus.intro: Drop this into any ticket. Fill the blanks. Prompt your agent.
bonus.outro_html: Save this. Come back to it every time a ticket feels too big to start.
